engineeringHealth.reason: Replacement Task 1-5 is a pure local foundation with strict fail-closed bounds, frozen identity regressions, an exact imported-callable owner gate, no runtime consumer, and original Task 3 inactive.

dataPrivacyBoundary.rawPluginText: ephemeral parser input only; it must not be persisted, logged, templated, queued, included in artifact evidence, or returned in output payloads.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Not applicable to this pure foundation because it has no runtime consumer or external write path.

closureCondition: Replacement Task 1-5 may close only on fresh local contract, owner-gate, frozen-identity and Harness control-plane evidence; original Task 3 stays inactive.
